Flow.description: Screen Flow: Individual Application Student Enrollment. The Board's Student Enrollment Application, filed on the portal by a school's School Administrator for a new student, a transfer or a student seeking additional training. Finds the student by name and date of birth (the date of birth is compared after the query, never filtered on) or adds them as a person, owned by the school's owner at the Board, never by the school. Asks the student's details, education, prior enrollment, course, schedule and class start date, the documents for the student type, and the school's certification, then creates a Student Registration application (Student Registration license type) with the $10.00 enrollment fee; a student's first in-state transfer is free. Nothing is written to the application until the school certifies; the documents wait on a draft.

fields.fieldText: The Student Enrollment Application is filed by a school's School Administrator. Your portal account isn't linked to a school as its School Administrator. Ask the Board to add you: call 225-756-3404.

fields.name: CS_Intro
fields.fieldText:
STUDENT ENROLLMENT APPLICATION

This form must be used to enroll all students in school, including new, transfers and those seeking additional training. Please provide the additional information as required for your student type along with this completed application.

A new student needs: a copy of their birth certificate (preferred) or driver's license for proof of age; a copy of their Social Security card; proof of education (must have completed the 10th grade or equivalent): a copy of their diploma or transcript; and two photographs measuring about 2 by 2 inches.

The enrollment fee is $10.00. A student's first in-state transfer is free.
